advisories.dependencyPath: riteway 9.3.0 (devDependency of every testing workspace) > vitest 3.2.7 > @vitest/mocker 3.2.7. better-auth lists vitest only as an optional peer, so riteway is what installs it.
advisories.reason: Path traversal in @vitest/mocker's redirect mock (moderate). Fixed in vitest 4.1.11, but riteway 9.x hard-depends on vitest ^3.2.4 for its riteway/vitest entry.
advisories.unreachable: Dev-only and never loaded: Acme's tests run on bun:test through riteway/bun, nothing imports riteway/vitest, vitest or better-auth/test, and no production image installs dev dependencies.

advisories.reason: Stack-exhaustion DoS on deeply nested brace patterns (high). No patched braces release exists yet (3.0.3 is the latest published version).
advisories.unreachable: Dev-only lint tooling: braces expands glob patterns written in this repository's own ESLint configuration, never untrusted input, and no production image installs dev dependencies.
